snippet.title: Tawa : Lost in time - Trailer (DEMO) - EN
snippet.description:
Tawa: Lost in Time - Official Trailer (Demo) | Prehistoric Adventure Game

Dive into the fascinating world of Tawa: Lost in Time, an adventure and survival game where you play as Tawa, a small mouse lost in a land of giant dinosaurs. Explore prehistoric landscapes, survive the dangers, and uncover secrets buried for millennia.

In this exclusive demo, experience immersive environments, unique environmental storytelling, and captivating gameplay.

Download the demo now on Steam and Itch.io to embark on the first step of this epic journey!

👉 Download the demo:
Itch.io : https://drex-the-drake.itch.io/tawa-lost-in-time

Steam : https://store.steampowered.com/app/3799840/Tawa_Lost_in_Time/
#TawaLostInTime #IndieGame #Adventure #Survival #Dinosaurs #PrehistoricGame
